model_input: RGB image only; no coordinates, IDs, segmentation or target truth
evaluation_labels: Renderer IDs used only offline to count true object pixels in fresh frames
limitations: Not general object recognition; same primitive arena colours and native MuJoCo renderer
Thresholds are engineering abstention rules; posteriors are not calibrated probabilities
No-grounding can mean occlusion, distant/small/shadowed object or out-of-domain colour
Visibility does not establish action completion or prevent repeat fetch of a still-visible ball
